text:
First, find the volume of the tank in cubic metres:  
Volume = length × width × height  
= 2.5 m × 1.8 m × 1.2 m  
= 5.4 m³  

The tank is 60% full, so the water volume is:  
Water volume = 60% of 5.4 m³  
= 0.60 × 5.4  
= 3.24 m³  

Convert cubic metres to litres (1 m³ = 1000 L):  
3.24 m³ × 1000 = 3240 L  

ANSWER: 3240
